Miasma sheet 2026-10-08 (owner): RM_SiltLampreyJuv (cast inline in RM_Miasma.xml, def in mandrake.rm.terminalbiomes) renamed gillclamper, description rewritten: The young of the silt lamprey, raised in the Miasma's warm stranding pools before the open sea takes it. A gillclamper is a finger-thick, eel-slick body behind a sucker of hooked rasps, which it fixes into the gill-slits of other young fish and feeds from while they swim. It has not yet grown the adult's full round maw; for now it latches on, clamps tight, and lets its host do the travelling.
